question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. 

Centre of public attention
solution:
The correct answer is Option (4) i.e. **'Limelight'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Centre of public attention: **(जन ध्यान का केंद्र)
 
• **Limelight**: (लाइमलाइट) - The focus of public attention
 
 
• **Example**: The young singer stepped into the limelight with her debut album.
 
 
 
• Limelight specifically means being the center of attention, which makes it the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Limelight'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ambiguity**: (अस्पष्टता) - (The quality of being open to more than one interpretation; unclear)
 
• **Obscurity**: (अज्ञातता) - (The state of being unknown, inconspicuous, or unimportant)
 
• **Fuzziness**: (धुंधलापन) - (A state of being indistinct or unclear)

48:T76e,

The correct answer is **Option 3.**
